result.description: Fires on the 'ay' piece in "Faraday" when it is tokenized as 'ad'+'ay' and followed by 's/'S (Faraday's law, experiments). Silent on 'ay' in misspelled or differently split names like Farawad-ay or Farad-ay.
result.label: 'ay' in Faraday's (ad-ay split)

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments ' Mes', ' Pale', ' Ne' that begin era or period terms (Mesozoic, Paleolithic, Neolithic, Mesopotamia), predicting continuations like 'ol', 'oz', 'o'. Members are detectors of these fragments.
result.label: Mes/Pale/Ne era-prefix fragments

result.description: Fires on ' make' when it is the first piece of the compound 'makeup', mainly 'genetic make|up', where the next token is likely 'up'. It stays silent on ordinary verb uses like 'must make wise'. Weak firing on some digits.
result.label: 'make' in 'genetic makeup'

result.description: Fires mainly on the token "BI" in the acronym "Business Intelligence (BI)", where it closes a multi-word term's abbreviation. Members detect "B" pieces, "intelligence", and acronym-forming initial words. Weak firing on a few other words, such as " unique".
result.label: BI acronym after Business Intelligence

result.description: Fires on sentence-ending periods (and colons) in cooking/culinary text about flavor, meat, and technique, especially where the document is about to start a new section. Predicts food-related continuations. Silent on periods in other topics.
result.label: Sentence-end period in culinary text

result.description: Fires on ' rather' in the "X, rather than Y" construction, where it is about to be followed by "than". It stays silent on "but rather" (no "than" expected). Members are mostly ' rather' detectors that promote ' than'.
result.label: 'rather' before 'than'
Social welfare/protection policy noun
result.description: Fires on the last word of social-policy terms such as "social protection", "social welfare" (the "are" piece), "safety" and "security". It predicts policy nouns next, like schemes, measures, programs, assistance. Silent in unrelated legal headings.

Fires on "both" right after a copula or "serving as" (can be both, is both, are both), introducing paired predicates ("both X and Y"). Silent on "both" as a determiner in "importance of both sides". Predicts adjectives or "a/an".
result.label: "both" after linking verb

result.description: Fires mostly on the 'ic' in "therapeutic" in music-therapy texts, often after "utilize/use/integrate". It stays silent on "therapeutic" in some other contexts and on other '-ic' endings (melodic, nostalgic). Members are music and therapy topic features.
result.label: therapeutic 'ic' in music therapy

result.description: Fires on the numeric prefix word pieces "multi" and "tri" (also "Multi") when a compound word is starting, such as multi-task, multiplayer or triangles. It predicts continuations like "ples", "player", "plex" and "angular".
result.label: multi- / tri- prefix pieces

result.description: Fires on the second ' as' of an equative comparison ("as important/adaptable/much X as"), where the next word introduces the compared term. Silent on ' as' meaning "serve as", "because", or "as an".
result.label: Second 'as' in equative comparison

result.description: Fires on the possessive 's after a scientist's surname (Gauss's, Ampère's, Euler's, Snell's) where a named law, theorem or equation comes next. Silent on 's after ordinary nouns like theory's or gravity's.
result.label: Possessive 's after eponymous scientist

result.description: Fires on tokens in acid-base chemistry text (pH, acid, dis-sociation, proton) where the next word is likely acid/base/buffer-related. Silent on 'proton' in physics or biology contexts. Members detect acid, base, OH and dissociation terms.
result.label: Acid-base chemistry context

result.description: Fires on ' health' as a standalone word, especially in "financial health" of a company. It is silent when "health" begins a compound like "healthcare". Members are mostly ' health' detectors, plus finance context members.
result.label: "financial health" word ' health'

result.description: Fires on the 'iv' token in 'pivotal' (after 'p'), predicting 'otal'. It stays silent on 'iv' in other words like 'captivating'. Members are 'iv' detectors that push 'otal'/'ots'.
result.label: 'iv' in 'pivotal'

result.description: Fires on the verb "serves" (also "serve") when a subject is about to be described as fulfilling a role, as in "X serves as Y". Members detect serve/serving and near-synonyms like act/acts, which feed it.
result.label: "serves" before "as" (role)

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " diplom" (also "plom" in e-diplomacy) in diplomacy/diplomat/diplomatic, anticipating a suffix like -acy or -atic. Members are mostly detectors of this same token.
result.label: diplom word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on ' English' (occasionally French/Spanish/Italian) when it names the language after a preposition or article, e.g. "in English", "the English language". It stays silent when English starts a sentence or modifies "grammar". Members are mostly English detectors.
result.label: ' English' as language name

result.description: Fires on the word ' data' (occasionally ' information' or ' datasets') as a noun after a modifier or verb, e.g. 'analyze numerical data', 'raw data'. Silent on 'big data' and 'data-driven'. Predicts continuations like sets, points, inputs.
result.label: ' data' token, not 'big data'

result.description: Fires on the word piece " Gen"/" gen" at the start of a word such as Genetic, genetics, genes, genres, GenBank, predicting continuations like 'etic', 'ome', 'omic'. Members are detectors of the same Gen/gen token.
result.label: Gen- word-start fragment
festival word (festival/festiv/Festival)
result.description: Fires on the word "festival" in its variants (' festival', ' Festival', ' festiv'), mainly in music-festival contexts. It weakly fires on similar event nouns like "event" or "events". Members are mostly festival-token detectors. Next-token logits favour "grounds" and "occasions".

Fires on the word piece 'ic' (also ' mechanical', ' mechan') completing "quantum mechan-ic(s)"; silent on 'ic' in other words like organic or microscopic. Predicts nouns like principles, effects, properties.
result.label: quantum mechan-ic ending

result.description: Fires on " through" meaning "by means of", after an abstract noun or verb phrase describing an outcome (growth through, diversity through). It is silent on "collected through CRM". Members are mostly "through" detectors.
result.label: "through" as means-of connector

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ge/ged/ges" after "emer" (emerged, emerges), where something comes into being; predicts "as" or "from". Members are detectors of emer+ge and related pieces (emerging, burgeon).
result.label: emer-ge-d word piece

result.description: Fires on the word "space" / "Space" (outer space, spacecraft, space missions), mostly in aerospace text. Members are detectors of the same token, and it predicts continuations like "craft", "flight", "missions", "stations".
result.label: "space" token (outer space)

result.description: Fires on time-span nouns (period, years, time, decades) right after "the" in phrases like "In/During the period/years...", where the next words give a bounded time frame (following, leading up to, between). Silent when the noun starts a sentence or follows "a".
result.label: "During the period/years" time-span noun
"om" piece inside bi-om-, nan-om-
result.description: Fires on the word piece "om" in the middle of a word, mostly after a prefix (bi-om-ass, bi-om-es, clin-om-eters, nan-om-aterials). It stays silent when "om" starts a word or follows "prote"/"gen" before "-ics". Weaker on "ver" in "Adverbs".

Fires mostly on ' teach' as the first piece of 'teachings', especially in Buddhist/spiritual religious-philosophy text, predicting a word-continuation suffix. Weaker, scattered peaks on other word-start pieces (large, aw, p).
result.label: ' teach' before '-ings' (spiritual)

result.description: Fires on the word piece "unn" in "tunneling" (t-unn-eling/elling), mostly in quantum or engineering contexts. It predicts the continuation "eling"/"elling"/"els". Weakly fires on "unn" in forerunners and funnels.
result.label: "unn" in "tunneling"
